021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
022import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
023
024/**
025 * Filter
026 *
027 * @author creatorfromhell
028 * @since 6.3.0.0
029 */
030public interface Filter<T> {
031
032  /**
033   * Determines whether the specified object satisfies the criteria defined by
034   * the implementation in the context of the given shop.
035   *
036   * @param shop  The shop to consider when evaluating the criteria.
037   * @param object The object to evaluate against the criteria.
038   * @return {@code true} if the object satisfies the criteria for the given shop,
039   *         {@code false} otherwise.
040   */
041  boolean applies(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull T object);
042}
